related.title: 奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦全球首部商轉的 EPR：1,750 MW 級發電機、蒸汽產生器與燃料完整性監測；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組則以首座開工的 EPR：熔融物滯留裝置、數位儀控多樣性與起動試驗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first EPR in commercial operation: a 1,750 MW-class generator, steam generators and fuel-integrity monitoring; Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit centres on the first EPR to start construction: core catcher, digital I&C diversity and start-up testing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「數位儀控的多樣性要求」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Diversity requirements for digital I&C", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧爾基洛托 3 號 EPR 機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkiluoto 3 EPR Unit must be respecified.

把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「海底冷卻水隧道與取排水頭」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subsea cooling-water tunnels and intake and outfall heads", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Hinkley Point C EPR 民用工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hinkley Point C EPR civil engineering must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 台山核電廠 EPR 機組
history.text: 2009 年1 號機開工；2018 年1 號機成為全球首部商轉的 EPR；2019 年2 號機商轉；2021 年1 號機停機檢查燃料。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2009: Construction of unit 1 began. 2018: Unit 1 became the first EPR in commercial operation. 2019: Unit 2 entered commercial operation. 2021: Unit 1 was shut down for fuel inspection. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
